description: ROBOCUS Market deck upgrade cards (5 Nov lineup, 6 Nov sim numbers). simField/simKey map to src/sim.js build fields (weapon, calibre=cal, arm, mod, helper, stat).

cards.name: Chief Engineer
cards.effect: Assign to a robot (max 3): fewer malfunctions, half the part breaks.

cards.name: Mechanic
cards.effect: +1 credit every Upkeep. Also a starter card.

cards.name: Accountant
cards.effect: Upkeep −1 for each robot after the first.

cards.name: Hacker
cards.effect: Once per round: peek at 1 face-down card on a rival robot.

cards.name: Market Analyst
cards.effect: See next round’s Market lots before you bid.

cards.name: Fixer
cards.effect: When you back a scheme, count +2 fame toward its gate.

cards.name: Security Chief
cards.effect: Your Security Bots block on 3–6 instead of 4–6.

cards.name: Repair Tech
cards.effect: Repairs cost half: 1 credit per 40 damage, rounded up.

cards.name: Laser Retrofit
cards.effect: Beam, 280 px range. Ignores armour and pierces every robot in line.

cards.name: Mortar Retrofit
cards.effect: Lobbed shell with splash. Lobs over walls; long range.

cards.name: Saw Blade Launcher
cards.effect: Ricocheting discs bounce off walls and robots, up to 3 hits.

cards.name: Flamethrower
cards.effect: Short fire cone that ignores armour. Burning robots spread fire.

cards.name: Spinner Blade
cards.effect: The whole robot spins: rams, hurls enemies, deflects 25% of bullets.

cards.name: Rapid-Fire Kit
cards.effect: 4 shots/s and a quick turret. Shreds light robots, weak vs armour.

cards.name: Heavy Cannon Kit
cards.effect: 0.5 shots/s, huge slow shells that punch through armour.

cards.name: Burst Gun
cards.effect: 3 quick shots, then a 0.8 s pause. About the damage/s of a medium gun.

cards.name: Heat Shield
cards.effect: Takes 40% off flame, laser and burning damage. −4% speed.

cards.name: Ablative Plating
cards.effect: Soaks the first 30 damage each fight, then falls off. −9% speed until then.

cards.name: Reactive Spikes
cards.effect: Rammers and spinners touching it take 12 damage; knockback and stun on it −50%.

cards.name: Composite Mesh
cards.effect: +1 Armour (max 4) with no speed penalty.

cards.name: Energy Shield
cards.effect: 25 HP bubble, recharges 10 HP/s after 3 s unhit.

cards.name: Decoy Hologram
cards.effect: At 60% HP a hologram pulls enemy fire for 2.5 s.

cards.name: EMP Burst
cards.effect: Stuns enemies within 150 px for 1.8 s.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.effect: Yanks an enemy 140 px toward you.

cards.name: Jump Jets
cards.effect: Leaps 160 px away when an enemy gets close.

cards.name: Oil Slick
cards.effect: Leaves oil puddles that make robots slide and spin.

cards.name: Medic Drone
cards.effect: Stays behind and heals its robot 4 HP/s.

cards.name: Waller Drone
cards.effect: Raises energy walls that stop bullets and lasers.

cards.name: Bodyguard Drone
cards.effect: Armoured drone that body-blocks bullets and saws.

cards.name: Gun Drone
cards.effect: Orbits its robot and fires 2 small shots/s.

cards.name: Spotter Drone
cards.effect: +15% accuracy, sees through smoke.

cards.name: Jammer Drone
cards.effect: Nearby enemy turrets turn at 45% speed.

cards.name: Reinforced Hull
cards.effect: +1 Health level. Each level costs 4% speed.

cards.name: Tuned Engine
cards.effect: +1 Speed. Level 4 adds 1 strain.

cards.name: Turret Motor
cards.effect: +1 Turret turn. Level 4 adds 1 strain.

cards.name: Targeting Chip
cards.effect: +1 Accuracy.

cards.name: Twin Turret
cards.effect: A second weapon slot: fit any weapon card at 60% firepower. Frame +20%, −5% speed.

cards.name: Quantum Shield
cards.effect: Module. Once per fight below 40% HP: 3 s of no damage, burning pauses.
